title: Show Untitled in the default Canvas window title
description: Make a newly launched Canvas window read `Drem Canvas — Untitled` while preserving the existing non-main branch suffix. Add a small pure formatter in `src/platform/WindowTitle.h`; `src/Main.cpp` must use that formatter for both macOS and Linux. The formatter must return `Drem Canvas — Untitled` for an empty, `master`, or `main` branch and append ` [<branch>]` for any other non-empty branch. This is a bounded operational pilot: do not add session-name tracking, persistence, or other title states.

observation.display_environment: native macOS window via Computer Use
preconditions: Canvas launches without loading a saved session.
The exact pilot binary is visible as a native macOS window.

steps.action: Launch Canvas without a session path
steps.expected_visible_result: A single Canvas window opens and its title identifies the application.

expected_behavior: The default window title clearly identifies that the project is untitled.
A feature-branch build retains its branch suffix for artifact identification.
negative_behavior: The title does not claim a saved project name.
The main and master branches do not add a branch suffix.

evidence.purpose: Content-addressed baseline showing the current native Canvas title before the Untitled label.

acceptance_criteria.description: A new Canvas window has the exact title `Drem Canvas — Untitled` on a mainline build.
verification_steps: Build the exact frozen artifact natively on macOS.
Launch it without a session path.
Read the native window title with Computer Use.
expected_behavior: The visible native title is exactly `Drem Canvas — Untitled`.
negative_behavior: No feature branch suffix appears for an empty, main, or master branch.

acceptance_criteria.description: A non-main branch remains identifiable after adding the Untitled label.
verification_steps: Run the focused formatter test for a representative feature branch.
Launch the exact feature artifact and read its native window title.
expected_behavior: The title is `Drem Canvas — Untitled [feature/example]` for the representative branch.
negative_behavior: The branch suffix is not duplicated or dropped.

exclusions: build-system changes outside the unit-test manifest

subtasks.title: Specify the default Untitled window-title contract
subtasks.description: Create focused unit coverage for empty, main, master, and feature branches. Add only the declaration/scaffold needed for the expected red-state test; do not implement the formatter behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement the Untitled window-title formatter
subtasks.description: Implement the pure header formatter exactly as specified by the paired tests. Do not modify tests or broaden into session state.

subtasks.title: Wire the formatter into Canvas startup
subtasks.description: Replace the local title construction in `src/Main.cpp` with the shared formatter for both supported platforms. Preserve source-file ceilings and make no unrelated startup changes.
